summary: British American Tobacco p.l.c. filed a Form 6-K reporting share repurchases from May 26-29, 2026, as part of its ongoing buyback programme announced March 18, 2024. The issuer purchased 471,544 ordinary shares at a volume-weighted average price of approximately 4,738 pence per share. Shares will be cancelled, reducing issued capital to ~2.168 billion shares. No premium or tender offer terms are stated. This is an open-market buyback, not a tender offer. Watch for continued execution pace and any updates to the buyback programme announcement.
